parts.name: Root
parts.description: The textarea control. It makes a native <textarea> element and puts each native attribute on it. It shows its state in data attributes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the textarea and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the textarea focusable, but stops the changes. The component sets `readonly` and `aria-readonly`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the textarea as not valid. The component sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the textarea required. The component sets `required` and `aria-required`.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the textarea element.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Makes the textarea taller with its content.

props.name: minRows
props.description: The smallest number of the rows that the user sees, with an automatic height.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: The largest number of the rows that the user sees, with an automatic height.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the textarea has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the textarea.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is required.
